tasks.title: Notify matches the patched contract and preserves padded addresses through channel sync and ledger reopen
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, R7, all preconditions, parity and M3 tests, existing tests and all Completion evidence; Rollout step 2 and M3, Releases/deploy/rollback; Evidence R2/R3 table; Non-goals clientName cap; Security impact; Performance impact; Acceptance evidence 4-8. Before editing require #820 closed, main's pin containing c5ce668 and current-pin-to-patch compare ahead; otherwise apply the specified holds. Preserve the native blocked-by #820 prerequisite for a person after fan-out. #810 has merged; after #820 expect b637302, not today's c5ce668. First write literal parity rows for every Evidence address (from and to[0]) and clientName input, including actual NUL and a written-out 64-character label: assert notify channelSchema success, contract public validator ok and literal notify 0464b90 boolean independently. Exclude the intentional 201..255-character cap difference. Before bump, exactly bold parity rows fail by contract-side assertion, non-bold controls pass. In the same file add both M3 cases: checkChannelsAnswer accepts the padded record with no rejection, and a temporary Ledger stores literal canonical D and returns the identical row after close/reopen. Both fail by assertion on old pin. Then bump package.json and bun.lock to the full main patch merge SHA (2.5.1 or next free patch). Notify's rules and all production src stay unchanged. Reader merges before api; retain existing SMTP-name and ledger checks. Include test CPU, startup import CPU/RSS, optional Docker full A/B or documented nightly fallback, and ledger/deployment/rollback evidence.

acceptance.expected: Before any edit, state is CLOSED; OPEN requires a needs-input hold naming #820. A person links the native blocked-by prerequisite after fan-out; do not edit while it is open.
Before any edit, record current main's full contract pin as CONTRACT_BASELINE_PIN for the ancestry checks; do not use version equality.
Before any edit, ahead or identical: main's pin contains the 2.4.0 baseline c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb. Otherwise request a needs-input hold.

Before any edit, ahead; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA is the full 40-character merge SHA independently obtained from the merged contract child PR implementing R1-R6 on main (2.5.1 on today's main, or the next free patch literal named in that PR). Identical or behind requires a hold because the patch is already present. Do not edit unless the precondition is established.

On patch, 0 fail. Every R2/R3 Evidence row gives notify 0464b90 literal boolean independently from notify and contract; address rows test from and to[0]. Include padded/plain/trailing/trailing-whitespace addresses, CR/LF, empty brackets, hostname/address-literals, localhost, underscore/non-ASCII/actual NUL/leading hyphen/empty label/trailing dot/[]/64-character label/empty/space clientName. Before bump exactly bold parity rows fail by assertion on the contract side, all non-bold controls pass on both. Exclude the intentional 201..255 cap difference. M3: valid-envelope padded record gives kind applied, one record with from === "Ops < ops@example.test >", rejected []; temp Ledger replaceRemoteChannels takes section literal D, revision sha256- plus 64 literal 1s, appliedAt 1, id mail without throwing; after close/reopen remoteChannels returns the identical row and definition === D. D is written literally, never derived as expected output from canonicalDefinition. Both M3 assertions fail on old pin (element rejected; LedgerRowError), then pass on patch. Focused coverage status is not its test result.
exit 0; package.json and committed bun.lock agree.

exit 0; lint, typecheck and full tests pass, including test/remote-channels.smtp-name.test.ts and ledger suites. Invalid mail/invalid may now fail at element level as the existing test permits (lines 46-50). Existing 80% coverage gate passes.

Both files pin the same full patch merge SHA; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA is the full 40-character merge SHA independently obtained from the merged contract child PR implementing R1-R6 on main (2.5.1 on today's main, or the next free patch literal named in that PR); the lockfile resolution matches that commit.

ahead or identical; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA is the full 40-character merge SHA independently obtained from the merged contract child PR implementing R1-R6 on main (2.5.1 on today's main, or the next free patch literal named in that PR), so the consumer pins a commit on contract main.
exit 0; notify's own channel/address/host rules and all production source are unchanged.
Before committing, only package.json, bun.lock and new test/contract-parity.test.ts are changed or untracked.

Performance impact: run five samples per side, alternating origin/main and branch with the matching dependencies installed; all full test runs pass. Report median user + system seconds per side and their delta in the PR, never substitute wall time. Expected test CPU increase about 0.1 s. A test CPU increase above 0.5 s is reported as a finding (Acceptance evidence 8).

acceptance.command: bun -e 'const t=process.cpuUsage(); await import("@lorenzh/pulse-contract"); const c=process.cpuUsage(t); Bun.gc(true); console.log((c.user+c.system)/1000, process.memoryUsage().rss/1048576)'
acceptance.expected: Performance impact: 15 fresh-process samples per side, alternating origin/main and branch after bun install on each side; report median import CPU ms and RSS MiB for each side and delta. Account for eager subscription module/schema evaluation through dist/index.js, even if no subscription validator is called. After #820 (2.5.0 baseline), expected no measurable import delta; otherwise expect about +1.4 ms CPU and +0.1 MiB RSS from the 2.5.0 pin move. A delta above 10 ms CPU or 2 MiB RSS is a finding in the PR.

Determine whether Docker with Compose is available for Performance impact's full A/B. If unavailable, record the specific blocker and name api's nightly bench on main (.github/workflows/bench.yml) as the gating check after merge; still complete local test CPU and startup import measurements.

When Docker with Compose is available, run pulse-api main's documented bench harness in a separate writable scratch checkout (API_BENCH_CHECKOUT; never mutate the read-only context clone); API_MAIN_SHA and NOTIFY_BRANCH_SHA are independently recorded main/branch commits. exit 0: no gating regression, B notify report observed, refs and measured table recorded in PR. Without Docker, record the blocker and nightly-main bench gate instead, as Performance impact permits.
exit 0; all required repository CI checks pass.

Records #820 CLOSED and pre-edit ancestry outputs; old-pin failures for exactly bold parity rows plus both M3 cases, all non-bold controls passing on both, full patch pass, independent implementations plus literal booleans per row and intentional 201..255 exclusion. Includes full main patch merge SHA/lockfile, full checks and unchanged src; test CPU and startup import A/B samples/medians/deltas/findings and full Docker A/B or nightly-main fallback. Includes applicable Security impact dependency-pin/input-validation review and ledger safety: all preexisting stored remote definitions passed unchanged notify local rules, so stricter contract rules do not invalidate them. States notify merges before api; rollback below patch requires rewriting padded database addresses, waiting for sync to replace the ledger row, then rolling back (otherwise old notify exits 2 at open). Carry api/console/notify patched-image release/deploy rule into the first deploy change; no deploy edit here.
